Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed Supplier as mentioned below:
a) General experience of the Supplier in the electro-mechanical works shall be five (05) years.
b) The minimum specific experience as Supplier in supply of similar nature of goods (including Fitting, Fixing, Testing &
Commissioning) in 3(Three) Contracts wtih total summation of value minimum Tk. 150 (One hundred fifty) Lac OR 2(Two)
Contracts with total summation of value minimum Tk. 120 (One hundred twenty) Lac OR Single Contract with a value of minimum
Tk.90 (Ninety) Lac, successfully completed within the last five (5) years in any Government/ Semi-Government/ Autonomous
Bodies /Private within Bangladesh. In case of Private, Certificate must be authenticated (verified) by the Executive Engineer of
PWD/PDB/DPDC/DESCO/BREB etc within his jurisdiction.
c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Letter of Commitment for Bank’s Undertaking for line of Credit as
per Form PG3-8 of Tender and Contract Forms must be submitted for this Purpose of the successful Tenderer shall not be less
than Tk. 150.00 Lac only. The Supporting Bank Document submitted along with the Tender must be issued in between Publication
date & Submission date of the Tender.
d) Supplier must have up-to-date ABC category Contractory License (License must be issued in favour of his own organization) &
Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing Board.
e)Supplier must have up-to-date Income Tax clearance Certificate.
f) Supplier must have VAT Registration Certificate.
g)Supplier must have up- to- date valid Trade License.
h)Supplier must be submitted a cmplete circuit diagram considering BOQ specifications included herewith.
(Years/Date will be counted backward from the date of publication of IFT)
